# funcd

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate.py from the funcd docs (v0.46.0). Copy this file, or its sections, into the
AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md of a project that builds on funcd. -->

This project runs on funcd, a single-binary serverless platform, through funcdctl. funcd is newer than most training
data: read its docs before writing a handler or a manifest, and never write a kind, a field, a flag or a status reason
that a page does not show. Each page below has a Markdown copy at its URL; a kind's fields are on its Spec tab, the
page's `spec.md`.

- Point funcdctl at the server with `FUNCD_SERVER` and `FUNCD_TOKEN`, or `--server` and `--token`. Before using a
  command or a flag, read its section of the
  [funcdctl Spec tab](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tools/funcdctl/spec.md), or run
  `funcdctl <command> --help`.
- Run locally with `funcdctl dev --gport 8080 --cport 8081` in the folder of the resource files (the dev build of
  funcdctl, and Node.js on the `PATH`, or Python 3.12 or later as `python3` or through `FUNCD_PYTHON`).
- Point the other commands at it with `export FUNCD_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:8081 FUNCD_TOKEN=funcd-dev-token`.
- Check every manifest with `funcdctl apply --dry-run -f <file>` and fix what it names until it prints `would apply`.
- When funcdctl computes a value (`funcdctl types`, `funcdctl backup plan schedule --rpo`, `funcdctl app render`),
  run it instead of writing the value by hand.
- Read the status with `get <kind> <name> -n default -o json` until `Ready` is `True`; the page's Status table explains
  every other reason; explain a reason with its row, and add no cause the row does not give.

## funcdctl commands (v0.46.0)

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `funcdctl app` | Manage Apps (render/deploy/delete/lock/history/rollback/pause/resume/retry) |
| `funcdctl apply` | Apply a manifest of one or more YAML documents, or JSON (- for stdin) |
| `funcdctl backup` | Platform backup: status (the daemon's report), verify (off the box) and plan (objectives into settings) |
| `funcdctl bench` | Load-test a deployed function's data-plane endpoint (throughput + tail latency) |
| `funcdctl delete` | Delete an object |
| `funcdctl describe` | Get an object (or list) as full JSON (get -o json) |
| `funcdctl dev` | funcdctl dev runs a folder's resource files from their local builds (dev build only) |
| `funcdctl eventing` | Eventing operations (dlq: inspect/replay/discard dead-lettered Sensor actions) |
| `funcdctl get` | List a kind, or get one object (table; -o json for the object) |
| `funcdctl hold` | The platform hold a restore or safe mode leaves (status/release) |
| `funcdctl index` | Combine per-platform pushes (push --platform) into one multi-arch OCI image index (prints <ref>@<digest>) |
| `funcdctl inspect` | Print a function artifact's I/O contract from its OCI metadata (no bundle pull, no run) |
| `funcdctl kvstore` | Manage KV stores (handover) |
| `funcdctl login` | Store registry credentials |
| `funcdctl logout` | Remove stored credentials for a registry |
| `funcdctl logs` | Print a function's logs (tenant-scoped to your identity) |
| `funcdctl plugin` | Plugins: `funcdctl <name>` runs funcdctl-<name> from PATH when <name> is no built-in command |
| `funcdctl pull` | Fetch an artifact by digest into a dir (verifies the digest) |
| `funcdctl push` | Package a function (a file or a bundle directory) — or, with --site, a prebuilt static web app, or with --template, an App template — as an OCI artifact and push it (prints <ref>@<digest>) |
| `funcdctl quarantine` | The data a start moved aside instead of deleting it, as no object named it (return) |
| `funcdctl types` | Generate FuncInput/FuncOutput + binding types from a contract file and its Function (.py / .d.ts; DX-only) |
| `funcdctl volume` | Function volume operations (delete a retained volume) |
| `funcdctl workflow` | Manage workflow runs (run/runs/pause/resume/cancel/describe/logs/replay) |

## Docs index (v0.46.0)

- **Introduction**
- [What is funcd?](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs.md): A lightweight, modular, single-binary serverless platform for Linux, designed for the agent era.
- **Get started**
- [Install](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/get-started/install.md): Install funcdctl on macOS or Linux, and the funcd server on Linux.
- [Quickstart](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/get-started/quickstart.md): Run a first Function on the local machine with funcdctl dev, call it, and read its logs.
- **Develop**
- funcd
  - [funcd](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/running-funcd.md): Start the funcd server, give it its settings in a file or in variables, and find every key and command it takes.
  - [funcd](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/running-funcd/spec.md): Every key of funcdconfig.yaml with its type, default, limits and variable, then every funcd command with its flags.
- Workloads
  - Function
    - [Function](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/function.md): Run a Function, call it, read its status and its logs, call one Function from another, serve HTTP, and scale to zero.
    - [Function, Revision and Invocation spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/function/spec.md): Every field of Function, Revision and Invocation, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.
  - App
    - [App](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/app.md): Install an App from its template, read its status and its parts, change a value, roll back, run its hooks, and delete it.
    - [App and AppRevision spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/app/spec.md): Every field of App and AppRevision: its type, its limits and its description.
  - Site
    - [Site](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/site.md): Serve a static web app with settings for each deployment.
    - [Site spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/site/spec.md): Every field of Site: its type, its limits and its description.
  - Workflow
    - [Workflow](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/workflow.md): Run a Workflow, start runs and read their steps and logs, branch on a step's output, share a database between steps, and retry, pause, cancel or replay a run.
    - [Workflow and WorkflowRun spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/workflow/spec.md): Every field of Workflow and WorkflowRun: its type, its limits and its description.
  - Configuration
    - [Configuration](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/configuration.md): Give a Function settings that are not secret through a ConfigMap, and read them in the handler.
    - [ConfigMap spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/workloads/configuration/spec.md): Every field of ConfigMap, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.config.
- Services
  - KV
    - [KV](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/kv.md): Declare a key-value store, bind its tables to a Function, and read and write keys from the handler.
    - [KVStore spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/kv/spec.md): Every field of KVStore, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.kv.
  - Bucket
    - [Bucket](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/bucket.md): Declare a Bucket and its prefixes, bind a prefix to a Function, and read and write its objects over S3 or through ctx.blob.
    - [Bucket spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/bucket/spec.md): Every field of Bucket, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.blob.
  - SQL
    - [SQL](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/sql.md): Declare a SQL database, bind it to a Function, and run SQL statements on it from the handler through ctx.sql.
    - [SQLDatabase spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/sql/spec.md): Every field of SQLDatabase, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.sql.
  - Lake
    - [Lake](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/lake.md): Declare a Lake over a Bucket prefix, bind it to a Function, and create and query its tables with SQL from the handler.
    - [Lake spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/lake/spec.md): Every field of Lake, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.lake.
  - Add-ons
    - [Add-ons](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/addons.md): Register an add-on built outside funcd, such as rauthy, declare its objects, back them up and sign users in through it.
    - [Build an add-on](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/addons/build.md): Package an engine built outside funcd as an add-on, with rauthy and its funcdctl plugin as the example.
  - Secrets
    - [Secrets](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/secrets.md): Create a Secret, bind it in a Function, read its values, and control which Functions can change its values.
    - [Secret spec and handler API](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/secrets/spec.md): Every field of Secret, then the methods a handler calls on ctx.secret.
  - Events
    - [Events](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/events.md): Call a Function or start a Workflow run when something happens, on a schedule, on a new object in a Bucket or on a row change in a SQL database, and handle the deliveries that fail.
    - [EventSource and Sensor spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/services/events/spec.md): Every field of EventSource and Sensor: its type, its limits and its description.
- Security and networking
  - Security
    - [Security](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/security-and-networking/security.md): Create an Identity for a client outside funcd, give roles to it and to Functions at a scope, and allow or forbid requests with a Cedar Policy.
    - [Identity, Role, RolesAssignment, Policy and OIDCProvider spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/security-and-networking/security/spec.md): Every field of Identity, Role, RolesAssignment, Policy and OIDCProvider: its type, its limits and its description.
  - Networking
    - [Networking](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/security-and-networking/networking.md): Serve a Function at a path and a host of its own with a Route, ask its callers to authenticate, and allow a Function's outbound connections with an EgressPolicy.
    - [Route and EgressPolicy spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/security-and-networking/networking/spec.md): Every field of Route and EgressPolicy: its type, its limits and its description.
- Tenancy and limits
  - Namespaces and resource groups
    - [Namespaces and resource groups](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tenancy-and-limits/namespaces.md): Delete the resources of a resource group as one, set the defaults of a namespace with a Namespace, and reach a namespace at its own host.
    - [Namespace and ResourceGroup spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tenancy-and-limits/namespaces/spec.md): Every field of Namespace and ResourceGroup: its type, its limits and its description.
- Disaster recovery
  - [Disaster recovery](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/disaster-recovery.md): Back up the stores of a namespace to an S3 bucket on a schedule, and restore a Backup into other stores or into the stores that it came from.
  - [Backup, BackupSchedule and Restore spec](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/disaster-recovery/spec.md): Every field of Backup, BackupSchedule and Restore: its type, its limits and its description.
- Tools
  - funcdctl
    - [funcdctl](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tools/funcdctl.md): The funcd CLI, which applies resources, reads their state and logs, and runs Functions on the local machine.
    - [funcdctl](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tools/funcdctl/spec.md): Every funcdctl command with its usage line, its text and its flags.
    - [Plugins](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/tools/funcdctl/plugins.md): A funcdctl plugin is an executable named funcdctl-<name> on PATH, which funcdctl runs as a command of its own.
- [Common definitions](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/common-definitions.md): The definitions every kind shares: its metadata and the conditions of its status.
- [Examples](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/develop/examples.md): The repositories that hold funcd's examples, from single functions to whole Apps.
- [API reference](https://pyvvo.github.io/funcd/docs/api.md): every operation of the control plane API and what it answers.
